creature_families: Boss: one giant creature record (Ragnaros) with HP-gated phases at 75, 50 and 25 percent, per-phase weak points and a timed attack set (Settings/AI/Unit/Behaviour Graphs/Ragnaros Bossfight - Behaviour Graph.asset)
Summoned copies: die beam clones that use the boss kit (Scripts/Client/Scenario/Behavior Graph/Actions/Bossfight/DieBeamCloneAction.cs)
Scripted hazards (not creatures): meteor maze rings, meteor corridor, rain of stars, die beam
Vehicle: Steam Tank, one vehicle record with four seats (Settings/Balance/Units/Vehicles/Steam Tank/)
Creature records without a read body: Super Zombie, Wooden Dummy
Transform forms from spells: Sheep (polymorph), Druid Cat (Cat Form); model-only, Rendering/Characters/
Naming mismatch: README features a Sirus boss; no Sirus creature record exists; the graph is for the other boss

top_creatures.label: Ember Colossus
top_creatures.why: A readable giant with a phase ladder and weak points that open per phase; the name plate is scaled up (nameplateSizeModifier 3).
top_creatures.keep: HP-gated phases, telegraph-then-strike cadence, per-phase weak-point windows.
top_creatures.change: Body, palette and element; not a lava-giant silhouette.
top_creatures.ref: Settings/AI/Unit/Behaviour Graphs/Ragnaros Bossfight - Behaviour Graph.asset line 257; Settings/Balance/Units/Creatures/Creature Info - Ragnaros.asset line 21

top_creatures.label: Ring Snare
top_creatures.why: A floor trap that states its escape rule before it fires.
top_creatures.keep: Rings appear one at a time with a sound each; escape timer; a meteor on failure.
top_creatures.change: Rising tide lines and a dune marker as the escape goal, not a meteor.

top_creatures.label: Echo Doubles
top_creatures.why: Copies that read as threats before they fire, with a turn-to-face warning.
top_creatures.keep: Spawn in a band around the target; turn during the warning; shared fire.
top_creatures.change: At most two echoes; staggered fire; they fade in.

top_creatures.label: Starfall Scatter
top_creatures.why: A ring-shaped scatter that gives a clear outer-then-inner read.
top_creatures.keep: Radial rings around the nearest player; near impacts first.
top_creatures.change: Slow glyph pulses with a lock delay; no falling meteors; no fire.

top_creatures.label: Three-Beat Slam
top_creatures.why: One attack that reads as three beats, each tunable alone.
top_creatures.keep: Three chained spell records (slam, arrival impact, shockwave).
top_creatures.change: Our own wind-up, stomp and ripple; no fire.
top_creatures.ref: Settings/Balance/Spells/Boss/Ragnaros Slam Spell.asset; Ragnaros Slam Shockwave Spell.asset; Ragnaros Slam Shockwave Arrival Spell.asset (names only)

top_creatures.label: Siege Tank
top_creatures.why: A vehicle with four named seat roles is a big, clear silhouette at 375 wide.
top_creatures.change: Our own mount with one gunner seat and one passenger seat.
top_creatures.ref: Settings/Balance/Units/Vehicles/Steam Tank/Vehicle Info - Steam Tank.asset; Vehicle Seat Info files (names only)

top_creatures.label: Critter Shift
top_creatures.why: A model swap as a status makes a dangerous target small and harmless for a moment.
top_creatures.keep: Timed model swap as a status.
top_creatures.change: Our own critter and tint; a visible timer on the health bar.
top_creatures.ref: Settings/Balance/Spells/Polymorph Spell.asset (record exists, body not read); Rendering/Characters/Sheep

top_creatures.label: Weak-Point Shell
top_creatures.why: Plates that light up in a random subset read as a puzzle during the fight.
top_creatures.keep: Random subset per phase; damage limit and multiplier on open plates.
top_creatures.change: A visible glow pattern; plates that close again.

originals.name: Tide Ring Snare
originals.idea: A floor trap of rings that appear one by one with a sound each, then a timed escape.
originals.keep: Telegraph before it fires; one escape rule per ring set; row 13 specials, row 23 zone set piece.
originals.change: Rising tide lines; escape by reaching a dune marker; no meteor.

originals.name: Starfall Scatter
originals.idea: Radial rings of slow glyph pulses around the nearest player, near impacts first.
originals.keep: The ring read and the near-first order; row 13 specials.
originals.change: A lock delay; glyphs, not meteors; no fire.

originals.name: Echo Doubles
originals.idea: Up to two copies placed in a band around the target, turning to face it during the warning, then firing staggered.
originals.keep: Placement band; turn-during-warning; shared fire; row 7 creature actor, row 13.

originals.name: Ward Phases
originals.idea: A giant with phase gates at three HP thresholds and weak-point plates that open per phase with a damage cap.
originals.keep: The gate ladder and the per-phase weak-point window; row 4 fight loop, row 13.
originals.change: Gates on ward stones as well as HP; our own body.

originals.name: Critter Shift
originals.idea: A timed model swap as a held status, with a timer on the health bar.
originals.keep: The swap as a held state; row 7 creature actor, row 13.

originals.name: Corridor Pull
originals.idea: A directed run with an escape band (forward test plus min and max distance) and one camera look-at on the anchor.
originals.keep: The escape band and the single camera pull; row 11 fight camera, row 23.
